name: StreamAll
blurb: Your playlists turned into television, on six Apple screens.
body: StreamAll turns your own playlists into a TV guide with channels, favourites and what's on now. It syncs through iCloud so your channels follow you from iPhone to Apple TV, Mac, iPad, Watch and Vision Pro, and it ships in 36 languages.

name: PIING
blurb: Private messenger: encrypted chats, groups, stories and calls, with no ads or trackers.
body: PIING is a private messenger with end-to-end encrypted chats, groups, stories and native calling through CallKit. There are no ads and no trackers, and the back end, admin console and website were all built by the studio.

name: Hectic Radio
blurb: Station site, listener app and a live DJ booth for London's broadcast network.
body: A station website, a listener app and a DJ booth for going live, with chat for listeners. Built so the station owns its audience rather than renting it from a platform.

name: Main Line Café
blurb: Website, ordering, a till, Apple Pay and a Wallet loyalty card for a Watford café.
body: An independent café's whole system: a website, online ordering, a till, Apple Pay and a loyalty card that lives in Apple Wallet, with no marketplace fees.

name: Forged Landscapes
blurb: Landscaping website with a project planner and client portal.
body: A landscaping company's website with a project planner that turns enquiries into briefs, and a client portal for quotes, files and messages.

name: Sourced London
blurb: Luxury vehicle sourcing and sales.
body: A showroom website for a luxury vehicle sourcing business, built to be fast, quiet and premium.

name: SAM
blurb: A free, private, local-first assistant that runs on your own devices.
body: SAM is an AI assistant that runs on your own Mac and devices, keeps your data local, and actually does the work rather than just chatting about it.

name: Divine
blurb: A web app built and run by the studio.
body: A web app designed, built and hosted by Hectic Software.

name: Bite Club LDN
blurb: Custom grillz designed in 3D, booked and followed from wax to snap-fit, in 36 languages.
body: A luxury grillz brand's website and iPhone app: design in 3D, book an impression, and follow your piece from wax to snap-fit. Available in 36 languages, with the iPhone app in beta.

name: DreamSpire Store
blurb: Streetwear storefront and shop back end.
body: A streetwear label's storefront and the shop system behind it.

name: RadioBox
blurb: Radio apps for iPhone and Android.
body: Radio apps published on both the App Store and Google Play.

name: Volero
blurb: Your Mac in your pocket. Fast, private, paired through iCloud.
body: Volero puts your Mac on your iPhone, iPad, Watch, Apple TV and Vision Pro. It pairs through iCloud with no account to make, and keeps the connection fast and private.

name: HecticTV
blurb: Shows and publishing for iPhone, Apple TV and Vision Pro.
body: A video platform with shows, playlists and publishing tools, built natively for iPhone, Apple TV and Vision Pro.

name: Fresh Face London
blurb: Clinic app with a booking engine, rewards and on-device AI.
body: An aesthetics clinic's app with its own booking engine, a clinic dashboard on iPad, rewards and an on-device AI assistant. Now in beta.

name: DreamSpire Native
blurb: A native shopping app for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Vision Pro.
body: The DreamSpire storefront rebuilt as a native shopping app across Apple's screens.

name: FlipIt
blurb: A paper-trading discipline app and site.
body: Practise trading discipline with paper money before risking real money.

name: StreamAll everywhere
blurb: StreamAll for Android TV, Fire TV, Roku, Samsung, LG and the web.
body: Taking StreamAll beyond Apple: native apps for Android TV, Fire TV, Roku, Samsung and LG televisions, plus the web.

name: Ghost Detail
blurb: A car detailing website.
body: A website for a car detailing business.

name: DJ Danny Hectic B
blurb: An artist website.
body: A home on the web for a DJ and artist.

name: HecticBullz
blurb: A booking website.
body: A booking website.

name: BLAM
blurb: Music recognition tuned to grime, drill, garage and drum & bass.
body: A concept for music recognition tuned to the UK underground.

name: HecticSuite
blurb: A self-hosted hub and admin for every Hectic brand.
body: A concept for one self-hosted admin and publishing hub across the Hectic group.

name: HecticMag
blurb: A digital magazine for the Hectic world.
body: The magazine you're reading, as an app.
